packageRules.description: Group all updates within a stack (helm/<stack>/values.yaml) into a single PR instead of one PR per image.
Auto-merge non-major bumps once CI passes; major bumps always need manual review. Because updates are grouped per stack, a group only auto-merges if every update in it qualifies here.

Major version bumps never auto-merge, regardless of package, and never group with a stack's routine minor/patch/digest bumps — a major landed disguised inside an otherwise-routine 'update helm/jeeva' PR twice (mongo 7->8, reverted in 16de7c1 and again in the mongo tag fix following PR #91) because grouping let a human merge it without noticing.
Immich server/ML move in lockstep and need release-note review before bumping.
Databases: slow-roll major/minor bumps, never auto-merge.
Floating-tag images: only digest bumps are meaningful; keep tag as-is.
